characters: A child with a toothbrush and a cup of clean water at a basin, smiling with clean teeth.

narrationPlan.pace: Brisk, matching the brushing beat (about 70 words per minute)
notes: Read dialogue with a different voice for each character.
Pause for two seconds at each question activity.
Never rush the last page: let the ending land.

music: A quick two-beat rhythm, like brushing, on a shaker (placeholder)
culturalNotes: Many families also clean teeth with a chewing stick. This chant uses a toothbrush; teachers may add other safe cleaning methods that families use.
reviewQuestions: Is the language right for the stated age band and reading level?
Is anything here inaccurate, stereotyped or unsafe for children?

Confirm with a dental or health source that brushing twice a day and rinsing is correct advice for young children, and that the advice about paste (a small amount, not swallowed) is added in the teacher notes.

teacherGuide.overview: A chant for the brushing habit. Form: four couplets. Rhyming pairs: light/right, row/slow, done/one, care/share. It teaches a daily habit and rhyme.
beforeReading: Ask: who has a toothbrush? When do you use it?
afterReading: Draw a happy tooth and a sad tooth.
Practise brushing with a model or an adult.
discussion: Why do we brush our teeth?
What sweet foods and drinks should we have less of?
reflection: Which habit will you keep every day?

support: Use a picture of the steps.
stretch: Write two new lines about drinking water for healthy teeth.

culturalNotes: Many families also clean teeth with a chewing stick. This chant uses a toothbrush; teachers may add other safe cleaning methods that families use.
localiseThis: Use the cleaning methods familiar to the children. Remind them to use only a pea-sized amount of paste and not swallow it. For children under three, a smear of paste (the size of a grain of rice) is enough, with an adult helping.

factCheck.explanation: Confirm brushing twice a day, the pea-sized amount (ages 3 to 6) and the rice-grain smear (under three) with a health source.
